dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: *sigh* I went out earlier than usual today, and I still missed the boat...

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Also, is it just me, or is this year's Lantern Rite busier than usual?

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Hello there, friend! Are you here to enjoy the night air as well?

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: I mean, look at all those lanterns. Really makes a guy want to play some cards!

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, wanna go for a round with me?

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Darn, missed the boat again...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Me? Oh nothing, other than the fact that I work on a ship. That ship that's just set sail to be precise...

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Getting up so early in the morning is my biggest hurdle. I never seem to get enough sleep.

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: I mean when there's so much to go out and do at night, how can anyone expect me to sleep!? Haha, no way. That whole "early to bed, early to rise" lifestyle... I'd rather be dead.

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Ahh... Seems the captain has forgotten about me for today. Guess I'll have to try harder to be up earlier tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Rex Lapis' death...

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Yeah, that... With Rex Lapis gone, could that mean the end for Liyue?

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Whenever I think about it, I just lose all my drive. I can't work, I get lost in my thoughts... I just can't snap out of it.

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: What? What do you mean I was already like that?

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Huh... Guess in that case I've already sunk about as low as one can go...

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Yep...

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Awesome.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'll see you around.

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Yeah, get going, aye. I think I'll just stay here by myself for a bit...

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Wanna play cards mate? Come, enjoy the night!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I dunno how to play...

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Really? You're missing out on all the fun!

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: At least you know to head outside and look for it though aye!

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Play some cards, listen to some music, experience the nightlife of Liyue. It's only in this moment that I truly feel like I'm living life, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: I'm living life, but what're you doing exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Pfft. Bye.

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Later. No doubt you're off to bed...

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Wow... The Mingxiao Lantern is really taking shape!

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: I've always loved Lantern Rite, ever since I was a kid. I never dreamed one day I'd be helping to build the actual Mingxiao Lantern!

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: I must get back to work. If I met myself as kid right now, he'd be so angry at me for slacking off on this... Tee-hee!
